mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username AS responder_name, h.title AS help_title FROM help_response r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.responder_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN help_request h ON r.help_id = h.help_id WHERE r.help_id = #{helpId} ORDER BY r.resp_time DESC

SELECT r.*, u.username AS responder_name, h.title AS help_title FROM help_response r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.responder_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN help_request h ON r.help_id = h.help_id WHERE r.responder_id = #{responderId} ORDER BY r.resp_id DESC
SELECT r.* FROM help_response r WHERE r.help_id = #{helpId} AND r.responder_id = #{responderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO help_response (help_id, responder_id, content, resp_time, status) VALUES (#{helpId}, #{responderId}, #{content}, NOW(), 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE help_response SET status = #{status} WHERE resp_id = #{respId}
